pk.context: 60 mg subcutaneous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear, colorless to pale yellow solution in a single-dose prefilled syringe

tell: Its RANKL target and boxed warning for severe hypocalcemia in advanced kidney disease set it apart.

clues.text: The drug shows no accumulation with repeated dosing, and renal impairment has no effect on its pharmacokinetics.
Produced in genetically engineered Chinese hamster ovary cells, with a molecular weight of about 147 kDa. Supplied as a preservative-free, sorbitol-containing solution.
Approved under a BLA, dosed once every 6 months.
Boxed warning for severe hypocalcemia in advanced kidney disease. Contraindicated with pre-existing hypocalcemia, pregnancy or hypersensitivity; back pain and arthralgia are common.
Osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and men at high risk for fracture, glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis, and bone mass in people on cancer hormone therapy.
Binds RANKL and prevents it from activating RANK on osteoclasts, inhibiting their formation, function and survival.
The generic name begins with D and has nine letters.
